blocks.text: North Korea said Wednesday it sees “no need” to hold dialogue with the United States, calling a U.S. accusation that it was involved in a cryptocurrency theft “an extension of Washington’s invariable hostile policy” toward the country, according to state-run media. Kim Yo Jong, sister of the country’s leader Kim Jong Un, said in a statement carried by the official Korean Central News Agency, “It is our clear stand that we have no need to sit face to face with such unreliable and hostile persons who refuse to abandon their policy of confrontation while talking about dialogue.” “The choice for peace […]...
